In the foreground, there are rough-hewn wooden planks and beams scattered on the ground. A figure wearing a light-colored shirt and dark pants is visible in the mid-ground, appearing to work with or stand near machinery. The background shows more wooden structures, beams, and what looks like a large wheel or pulley system. The lighting is natural but somewhat dim, suggesting an open-sided shed or workshop environment. The overall texture is gritty and aged.
